notes: Headlamp bezel-to-housing screw. One CorvetteForum post (thread page 403, only search snippets) gives #8 sheet metal, dome-style head for the screws on a '71 and names 9427748 as the AIM number for them; snippets are fragmentary (a length 'of 1/2"' appears but its context is cut), so length not recorded. Searches: 'GM 9427748', '9427748 AMK', '9427748 screw headlamp bezel'.

sources.title: Need specs for Screws: 79 Headlamps - CorvetteForum (search snippet)
sources.quote: The screws on my 71 that hold the cover around the headlights (4 each headlight) are size 8, sheetmetal thread, dome style h ... The GM number in my 71 AIM for the screws is #9427748
